describe: TSMC's revenue guidance for the following quarter, as stated in each quarterly results release from 2001Q4 to 2026Q3, collected on 2026-11-22 from the release PDFs on investor.tsmc.com. 85 releases give a numeric range (guided quarters 2005Q4 to 2026Q4); the 15 before the 2005Q3 release give none. Ranges are in NT$ billion through the 2017Q1 release and in US$ billion from the 2017Q2 release; unconsolidated through the 2005Q4 release, consolidated from the 2006Q2 release, and both for 2006Q2.
checks: Per the collection: every range was matched against a second TSMC source (the results page table or the presentation slide), and every release date matches announcement_dates_2002_2026.json. Those checks were not repeated here. No midpoint was computed and no currency converted in this file.
caveats: low and high are the original guidance; four known mid-quarter revisions are in guidance_revision and revisions before 2012 were not searched for.
Assumed exchange rates for the 2008Q1 to 2011Q2 releases come from the presentation slide only.
